title: Padding after a UTF-16 NUL unit is neither decoded nor validated
description: 41 00 00 00 00 D8 41 00: 'A', the NUL code unit, then a lone high surrogate. With bddo:trimNull only the bytes before the NUL are the value; the lone surrogate is in the padding, so the value is 'A' and there is no error.
